decisions.reason: The data processing agreement tool draws on the firm's documented compliance know-how and fits its stated push into compliance capabilities, and agency praise for its templates gives a readable signal that its own R&D can keep building on.
The flagship management platform extends the firm's owned infrastructure and integrated tooling, which places it at the core of its absorptive capacity and of its agency-focused platform strategy.

Extended PHP security support builds directly on the firm's containerized hosting and security expertise and serves agencies running legacy client sites, though the limited evidence from its early market presence leaves some uncertainty.
